name: Android Texter
description: Android Texter turns your Android phone into an SMS gateway so you can send and receive text messages through its REST API.

events.d: Add a contact or update the existing contact with the same phone number.
Send a text message from a linked Android phone, now or at a scheduled time.
Send a personalized text to up to 500 phone numbers with optional media and device selection.
Get the delivery status of a sent message by its message ID.
